AdminSettings.description: The Admin API and the dashboard.

listen.description: Address of the Admin API and the dashboard.

token_file.description:
File holding the Admin API token, created with a random token on first start if missing.
A relative path is resolved against `storage.data_dir`.

Certificate.description: A certificate chain and its private key, read from PEM files.

cert.description: PEM file with the certificate chain, leaf certificate first.

key.description: PEM file with the private key.

ConfigSettings.description: Where the dynamic settings come from.

source.description: Source of the dynamic settings: listeners, certificates and the other entity tables.

oneOf.description:
The database. Changes go through the Admin API or the dashboard and are kept as versions.
Dynamic settings in the configuration file are ignored.
The configuration file. Edit it and send SIGHUP to reload; the dashboard is read-only.

Listener.description: A set of addresses served with one protocol.

listen.description: Addresses to listen on, such as `["0.0.0.0:443"]`.

tls.description: TLS termination. Without it the listener serves plain TCP.

certificates.description: Names of the certificates the listener can present. The client's SNI picks one.

level.description: Log filter in `tracing` directive syntax, such as `"info"` or `"info,zora_runtime=debug"`.

oneOf.description: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, served by the gateway.

shutdown_timeout.description: How long open connections may take to finish after a shutdown signal.

threads.description: Worker threads of the data plane. `0` starts one per CPU core.

StorageSettings.description: Where zora keeps its database and runtime state.

data_dir.description:
Directory for the database and runtime state. A relative path is resolved against the
directory of the configuration file.

admin.description: The Admin API and the dashboard. Static: a restart applies changes.

certificates.description:
TLS certificates by name. Dynamic: read from this file only when `config.source` is
`"file"`.

config.description: Where the dynamic settings come from. Static: a restart applies changes.

listeners.description: Listeners by name. Dynamic: read from this file only when `config.source` is `"file"`.

log.description: Logging. Static: a restart applies changes.

server.description: Process settings. Static: a restart applies changes.

storage.description: Where zora keeps its database and runtime state. Static: a restart applies changes.

version.description: Version of the configuration format. This build reads version 1.
